payoutProtocol.title: 网关接入协议
payoutProtocol.connection: 自行部署支持以下协议的 HTTPS 公网网关，将基础地址填入上方。禁止重定向，基础地址不能包含账号密码、查询参数或片段。使用 32–1024 个随机 ASCII 字符作为签名密钥，两端保持一致。
payoutProtocol.requests: 两个端点均使用 POST 和 application/json，带下例中的签名请求头。提交包含账户标识；查询只发送 event_key。amount_minor 为整数，100 个最小货币单位等于 1 个主单位；例如 amount_minor=1250、currency=USD 表示 12.50 美元。只使用设置页提供的两位小数币种。
payoutProtocol.signing: X-AnyFlows-Timestamp 是 UTC Unix 秒。签名是 HMAC-SHA256(key, timestamp + 换行符 + 原始 UTF-8 正文字节) 的 64 位小写十六进制字符串；密钥按原始 UTF-8 字节使用。网关先验签并检查时间，再处理请求。以下 Node.js 示例也可用于签署响应；原始 body 必须直接发送，签名后不要重新序列化或改空白。
payoutProtocol.response: 成功读取回执必须返回 HTTP 200、JSON 正文以及 X-AnyFlows-Timestamp 和 X-AnyFlows-Signature 响应头，按响应原始正文独立签名；响应时间与平台时间相差最多 300 秒。event_key、amount_minor、currency 必须与原交易完全一致；查询也返回原交易金额和币种。不要增加示例之外的 JSON 字段。
payoutProtocol.states: status 可为 paid、processing、rejected、unknown 或 not_found。paid 必须包含非空 reference（最多 256 个 UTF-8 字节，不含控制字符）；其他状态可省略 reference。只有签名有效的 rejected 表示明确失败并释放锁定资金。超时、HTTP 错误、签名异常、unknown 和 not_found 均保留锁定资金，后续只查询，不重复提交转账。
payoutProtocol.idempotency: 网关必须永久保存 event_key 并按 Idempotency-Key 去重，同一键始终代表同一笔转账；重启、多实例和重复请求都不能产生第二笔转账。账户标识由网关自行解释并关联真实收款方；平台不会推断银行账户或代接支付机构。

payoutProtocol.title: Gateway integration protocol
payoutProtocol.connection: Deploy a public HTTPS gateway implementing this protocol and enter its base URL above. Redirects are prohibited. The base URL must not contain credentials, query parameters or fragments. Configure the same signing key on both sides: 32–1,024 random ASCII characters.
payoutProtocol.requests: Both endpoints use POST with application/json and the signing headers shown below. Submission includes the account token; queries send only event_key. amount_minor must be an integer, with 100 minor units per major unit: amount_minor=1250 with currency=USD means USD 12.50. Use only the two-decimal currencies offered in these settings.
payoutProtocol.signing: X-AnyFlows-Timestamp contains UTC Unix seconds. The signature is the 64-character lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256(key, timestamp + newline + raw UTF-8 body bytes), using the key as raw UTF-8 bytes. Verify the signature and timestamp before processing requests. This Node.js example also signs responses. Send body unchanged; do not reserialize JSON or change whitespace after signing.
payoutProtocol.response: Return HTTP 200, a JSON receipt, and X-AnyFlows-Timestamp and X-AnyFlows-Signature response headers, signing the raw response body separately. The response timestamp must be within 300 seconds of platform time. event_key, amount_minor and currency must exactly match the original transfer; query receipts also include its original amount and currency. Do not add JSON fields beyond this example.
payoutProtocol.states: status may be paid, processing, rejected, unknown or not_found. paid requires a nonempty reference of at most 256 UTF-8 bytes without control characters; other states may omit reference. Only a valid signed rejected receipt confirms failure and releases held funds. Timeouts, HTTP errors, invalid signatures, unknown and not_found retain the hold. Subsequent requests query the result without submitting another transfer.
payoutProtocol.idempotency: Permanently retain event_key and deduplicate using Idempotency-Key. The same key always identifies the same transfer; restarts, multiple instances and duplicate requests must never cause a second transfer. The gateway resolves account tokens to real recipients. The platform does not infer bank details or provide an automatic payment-provider integration.
